`LAR-GAP10K-SysArch-initial` — reviewed **646b54378fd2d1ae198100174276478509c19e17**.

The proposed translation is a coherent **conditional ECAL-only response experiment**. I found no physical reason to prevent that isolated study, provided the declared geometry and native-validation gates pass. It does not establish a viable integrated 400 mm gap.

- **Apply signed motion to assembly-level placements.** `LArEndcaps` contains both signs in one assembly. Move side1 roots by global **−400 mm z**, side2 by **+400 mm z**; preserve rotations. The expected changes are **4928 wheel replicas +36 parentless passive pieces =4964 z attributes**. Pieces with `parent_name`, including rear support, boards and cooling branches, retain their local poses. Translating the common detector assembly or every XML piece would be wrong. [Factory ownership](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/646b54378fd2d1ae198100174276478509c19e17/prototypes/calorimeter/LArEndcap.cpp#L94-L133), [export structure](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/646b54378fd2d1ae198100174276478509c19e17/tools/lar_calorimeter/endcap_export.py#L64-L73)

- **Local readout can remain unchanged.** Turbine cell assignment uses local radius/z, and canonical references are local. Keeping frames, tables and IDs fixed therefore preserves membership under rigid translation; global references must acquire the same signed displacement. Retain the proper negative-side rotation, whose determinant is +1. Expected inventories remain **9856 endcap raw IDs,1203200 endcap logical cells**, and **43648 combined raw contexts**. [Segmentation](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/646b54378fd2d1ae198100174276478509c19e17/prototypes/calorimeter/LArEndcap.cpp#L52-L70)

- **Derived endpoints:** wheel centres become **±4835 mm**; warm packages occupy **|z|4500–5460**, sampling **4610–5060**, and rear supports **5070–5100 mm**. Fixed barrel warm/active ends4100/3910 give **400/700 mm** separations. Entire endcap subtrees remain rigid, so existing internal geometry is preserved and no new barrel/endcap solid contact is expected from these envelopes. Native verification remains required.

- **Preserve the world and all non-placement XML.** `combined_native.build()` derives world_z from endcap envelope metadata; rebuilding it with shifted metadata could introduce an unintended world-boundary change. Compare normalized trees allowing only the4964 signed z changes, bind the candidate separately, and verify all transformed native centres, IDs, material inventories and unchanged local references. Complete the **10 nm ECAL-union overlap scan before showers**. [Builder](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/646b54378fd2d1ae198100174276478509c19e17/tools/lar_calorimeter/combined_native.py#L37-L76), [prospective gates](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/646b54378fd2d1ae198100174276478509c19e17/docs/validation/lar-gap10k/protocol.md#L15-L39)

The study preserves constituent inventory, **not directional material budgets**: translating the endcap changes illumination throughout it. New straight-ray envelope limits are approximately **1.276–3.208** for any intersection and **1.357–3.115** for full axial-depth containment. Neither establishes efficiency or seamless shower depth.

External limitations remain substantive: the prospective collar conflicts with the moved endcap; front service routing, sealed penetrations and installation remain unresolved. With HCAL fixed, rear EC space would become900 mm but the full radial-exit window remains500 mm. These omitted systems do not invalidate the authorized isolated experiment. [Proposal limitations](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/646b54378fd2d1ae198100174276478509c19e17/docs/design/inputs/DES-032-side-rear-routing.md#L102-L114)

Actual checks: verified all **12 supplied hashes**; inspected pinned geometry/export/readout/transport inputs and additional pinned service/configuration sources; independently calculated counts, endpoints, rotation determinants and envelope bounds. **No files changed or native jobs run.** Candidate construction, native invariants and overlap results remain pending.
